primary_sources.title: Vassilevich, Heat kernel expansion: user's manual
primary_sources.reviewed: The complete mixed-boundary a4 formula (5.33), including the 30 chi f_;iin term and the first and second smearing derivatives, opened directly.
primary_sources.use: The possible third smearing-derivative contact is proportional to tr chi and vanishes in the actual balanced domain. Lower derivative contacts and the retained common heat subtraction remain explicit.

source_access: The primary review and formula were opened directly. No downloaded-byte digest is claimed.
strongest_comparator: The preceding conformal-only incompatibility leaves the independent shape correction open. The stationary canonical C1 action theorem fixes a convergent cubic jet and cannot be applied to oscillatory cubic metric families without a new argument. Its fixed-seed finite-cut profile calculation does supply the distributions needed for the first-variation extension proved here.
hardest_step: Prove finite-cut convergence of the canonical first variation on C^(2,alpha) cubic directions, rather than assuming pointwise source asymptotics or C3 regularity. Then combine the full local shape endpoint term with the trace equation; their operator rows are exactly dependent.
new_consequence: For the stated family with first-order conformal fast data and second-order conformal/shape tails, every bounded trace-compatible pair leaves the same strict nonzero quadratic cutoff oscillation. The canonical first variation contributes a finite constant. This closes that coupled second-order repair, without excluding arbitrary first-order shape responses or all physical fast metrics.
regulator_contract: The original fixed background cut, actual paired domain, common subtraction and finite coefficients. No moving physical-area regulator or new boundary functional is adopted.
exploratory_work: Before source freeze, exact symbolic differentiation of the original areal shape action recovered both leading coefficients and the zero determinant of the trace/action operator rows. These were development calculations, not acceptance runs.
verification_scope: Exact original-action shape differentiation, operator identities, refined charged annular action fixtures, unexpanded Taylor extraction and nonsmooth finite-part translation controls. No full determinant or physical mode is numerically evaluated.
